frequency_question: How often do central banks implement temporary liquidity-absorption reserve mandates when interbank liquidity indicators reach specific tightening precursor states?
membership_rule: Includes any formal central bank announcement of incremental or special reserve ratio hikes designed to absorb surplus liquidity. Excludes standard benchmark interest rate changes or permanent statutory reserve ratio shifts.
window: Any multi-month operational window following observed liquidity surge precursors.

skeleton: Major emerging market central bank liquidity management cycles over the past 20 years where banking system liquidity overhang triggered targeted instrument deployment.
multiplier: 4 observed historical deployments of targeted temporary liquidity absorption ratios out of roughly 12 identified major liquidity overhang episodes in emerging market jurisdictions.
validity_reason: Central bank operating frameworks and liquidity management toolkits evolve slowly over multi-year periods.
